# Frame Morph

**Morph › Shape** · v1.0.0 · 40 frames at 30 fps (20–80)

The whole frame rounds and shrinks into a circle, the picture inside becomes the new scene, and the circle grows back into the full frame.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/frame-morph@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Changing topic with one continuous object
- App and UI demos
- Playful explainers

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import frameMorph from './transitions/07-morph/shape/frame-morph';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(frameMorph, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 40 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `background` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | Colour that closes in around the shrinking frame; use the incoming scene's background colour. |
| `size` | number | `0.42` | 0.15–0.8 | Circle size at the middle, as a share of frame height. |
